subject: 3 website opportunities for Homestay Hotels
body:
Hi Homestay Hotels team,

I reviewed the Homestay Hotels website from a guest-journey perspective and noticed three opportunities.

The reviewed site did not use an encrypted connection, the mobile setup may be less consistent on smaller screens and a clear booking or enquiry step was not apparent in the reviewed pages.

Together, these can affect visitor trust, mobile guest experience and the booking or enquiry journey.

PlaneByte can address this through a mobile-first website and technical foundation upgrade, with a clearer booking or enquiry journey, rather than simply changing the visual design. For an eligible website project, we can also include SEO launch foundations, basic external security configuration review and post-launch technical validation within the agreed scope.

I've attached a short review showing what we found and what we'd prioritise.

If this is already on your roadmap, reply here and I can send over a suggested priority order and rough implementation scope.

Best,
Piyush | PlaneByte
Founder
Software Engineering · SEO · Security
https://planebyte.com
contact@planebyte.com

top_findings.title: The public experience still uses HTTP
top_findings.observation: the page we reached was served over HTTP
top_findings.evidence: Traffic to the observed page is unencrypted.
top_findings.impact: Unencrypted browsing can create trust and data-protection concerns for visitors.
top_findings.improvement: Consistent HTTPS across the public journey, with redirects and certificate checks.

top_findings.title: A clearer experience on smaller screens
top_findings.observation: a mobile viewport declaration was absent from the reviewed HTML
top_findings.evidence: No viewport declaration in observed HTML.
top_findings.impact: Potential customers may have to work harder to read content or reach the next step on a phone.
top_findings.improvement: Responsive page templates with a verified mobile layout and clear next steps.

top_findings.title: Make the next enquiry easier
top_findings.observation: a prominent booking or enquiry action was not found in the sampled links
top_findings.evidence: A clear service enquiry action was not found among the sampled links.
top_findings.impact: Interested visitors may not have an obvious route from browsing to contacting the business.
top_findings.improvement: A visible primary action and a tested enquiry or booking journey.

included_value.title: SEO launch foundations
included_value.description: Core page titles, descriptions and crawlability checks for the agreed pages.

included_value.title: Basic external security configuration review
included_value.description: Public HTTPS and browser configuration checks, with hosting dependencies documented.

included_value.title: Post-launch technical validation
included_value.description: Recheck the agreed pages, enquiry paths and technical setup after launch.
